title: Winda WD-F1512
subtitle: Knit Fabric Inspection and Relax Machine (Pre-Sewing Preparation)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Winda WD-F1512 is a knit fabric inspection and relaxation machine used BEFORE sewing to relieve knitting/finishing tension and align fabric edges for downstream cutting and sewing. Combines fabric inspection, measurement, loosening (folding), and edge alignment in a single pass.
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment CAD/CAM workflow, knit garment production, sportswear

overviewDescription: The Winda WD-F1512 is part of Winda Technology Limited's (Shenzhen, China) 'Fabric Relax & Inspection Series' under their 'Machines For Sewing Process' product line. Performs fabric inspection, measurement, loosening (folding), and edge alignment. Output format: fold-to-fold or roll-to-fold. Suitable for knit, woven, and spandex fabrics.
